evaluation.primary_reason: lowest integer priority among all active reasons
evaluation.secondary_reasons: remaining active reasons sorted by priority then reason_code

numeric_representation.money: integer cents unless field suffix is _micros

rules.recovery_action: Submit a new intent whose pessimistic projected value is within the applicable limit; closing or reducing existing risk may be required first.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: projected trade risk is {projected_risk}, above your {limit} maximum. Reduce quantity or tighten a valid protective stop.

rules.recovery_action: Remain risk-reducing only through the next valid trading session, then reconcile broker and ledger state before a new risk session.
rules.user_message: Trading locked for today: your daily loss is {daily_loss}, at or beyond the {limit} limit. You may only reduce or close positions.

rules.recovery_action: Complete the weekly cooldown defined in section 4.4 and reconcile; a restart, deposit, or profile change does not shorten it.
rules.user_message: Trading locked: rolling five-session loss is {weekly_loss}, at or beyond the {limit} limit. You may only reduce or close positions.

rules.recovery_action: Complete every drawdown recovery and probation requirement in section 4.4; paper requires one authorized operator to clear after evidence, future live requires two.
rules.user_message: Trading locked: account drawdown is {drawdown}, at or beyond the {limit} limit. Risk review and paper recovery are required.

rules.recovery_action: Complete the profile cooldown in section 3; where a half-risk probation trade is required, pass it without another loss.
rules.user_message: New trades paused after {count} consecutive losses. The pause ends {resume_condition}.

rules.recovery_action: Submit a new intent whose pessimistic projected value is within the applicable limit; closing or reducing existing risk may be required first.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: projected total open risk is {projected_risk}, above the {limit} maximum.

rules.user_message: Order blocked: today’s accepted new-risk budget would become {projected_risk}, above the {limit} maximum.

rules.recovery_action: Submit a new intent whose pessimistic projected value is within the applicable limit; closing or reducing existing risk may be required first.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: it would create {projected_count} concurrent positions; this mode allows at most {limit}.

rules.recovery_action: Submit a new intent whose pessimistic projected value is within the applicable limit; closing or reducing existing risk may be required first.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: projected {symbol} notional is {projected_notional}, above the {limit} maximum.

rules.recovery_action: Submit a new intent whose pessimistic projected value is within the applicable limit; closing or reducing existing risk may be required first.

rules.recovery_action: Submit a new intent whose pessimistic projected value is within the applicable limit; closing or reducing existing risk may be required first.

rules.recovery_action: Submit a new intent whose pessimistic projected value is within the applicable limit; closing or reducing existing risk may be required first.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: projected exposure to correlated cluster {cluster_id} is {projected_exposure}, above the {limit} maximum.

rules.recovery_action: Obtain valid point-in-time sector or ETF look-through classification, or reduce Unknown exposure below the profile limit.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: sector classification is unavailable or exceeds the Unknown-sector allowance.

rules.recovery_action: Do not add; wait until the conservative mark is no longer adverse and submit a distinct signal that meets the favorable-add rules, or close/reduce the position.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: adding while the position is losing is not allowed.

rules.recovery_action: Recompute size with an approved loss-independent model and submit a new intent with audited sizing inputs.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: position size may not increase in response to losses or drawdown.

rules.recovery_action: Restore the feed and meet the three-valid-update recovery test in section 5.1, then create a new decision from fresh data.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: the latest quote is {quote_age_ms} ms old; this mode requires {limit_ms} ms or less.

rules.recovery_action: Restore the feed and meet the three-valid-update recovery test in section 5.1, then create a new decision from fresh data.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: the current bid/ask quote is invalid, locked, crossed, or incomplete.

rules.recovery_action: Restore the feed and meet the three-valid-update recovery test in section 5.1, then create a new decision from fresh data.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: required market data is disconnected, incomplete, or out of sequence.

rules.recovery_action: Wait for both spread measures to return within limits and submit a newly evaluated intent.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: the bid/ask spread is {spread_abs} ({spread_pct}), above the allowed {limit_abs} or {limit_pct}.

rules.recovery_action: Wait for both sides to meet share and notional depth limits, and keep order participation within the profile cap.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: displayed executable liquidity is below {share_limit} shares and {notional_limit} on one or both sides.

rules.recovery_action: Use an eligible instrument with 20 complete prior sessions and sufficient median dollar volume; intraday activity cannot cure the block.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: 20-day median dollar volume is {value}; this mode requires at least {limit}.

rules.recovery_action: Use an eligible instrument with 20 complete prior sessions and sufficient median dollar volume; intraday activity cannot cure the block.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: 20 complete trading sessions of dollar-volume history are not available.

rules.recovery_action: Wait for a fresh executable-side quote at or above the minimum, or select an eligible instrument.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: the executable price is {price}; this mode requires at least {limit}.

rules.recovery_action: Select an approved US-listed common stock or allowlisted ETF.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: this instrument type is not eligible for day trading.

rules.recovery_action: Supply healthy, entitled SIP/full-market data for the complete decision; a warning or user acknowledgement is insufficient.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: consolidated full-market data is required for this decision; IEX-only coverage is insufficient.

rules.recovery_action: Verify contractual entitlement and technical access for the intended automated use before a new decision.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: the required market-data entitlement or automated-use right is not verified.

rules.recovery_action: Complete the applicable cooldown and continuous-normalization test in section 6.1.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: measured volatility is {value}, at or above the {limit} limit. Recheck after {eligible_time}.

rules.recovery_action: Wait through the gap window and normalization test in section 6.5; a 10% gap remains blocked for the session.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: {symbol} opened {gap_pct} from its prior adjusted close, at or above the {limit} gap threshold.

rules.recovery_action: Wait for confirmed resumption, complete the post-halt waiting period, and pass quote, LULD, and volatility checks.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: {symbol} is halted or its halt status is unknown. New trades remain paused until the post-halt waiting period ends.

rules.recovery_action: Wait for valid bands and continuous trading for five minutes after the pause, outside the 0.25% band buffer.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: {symbol} is paused, in a LULD straddle, or too close to a price band.

rules.recovery_action: Obtain valid borrow/SSR state and submit an eligible short order after every applicable restriction clears.
rules.user_message: Short order blocked: short-sale restriction or borrow status does not permit this order.

rules.recovery_action: Use a long-only intent or a separately approved profile where shorting is enabled; no in-session profile change may release the order.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: short selling is disabled in this mode.

rules.recovery_action: Wait for a supported regular session and submit a new day order.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: day-trading orders are allowed only during the regular market session.

rules.recovery_action: Remove auction instructions and submit only during an allowed continuous-trading window.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: opening and closing auction orders are not supported.

rules.recovery_action: Wait until the later applicable opening restriction ends and re-evaluate with fresh state.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: new risk is prohibited during the first minute after the official open.

rules.recovery_action: Do not open new risk; cancel openings and reduce/close positions before the profile deadline.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: new risk is prohibited during the final minute before the official close.

rules.recovery_action: Wait until the later applicable opening restriction ends and re-evaluate with fresh state.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: new positions are paused after the open until {eligible_time} ET.

rules.recovery_action: Do not open new risk; cancel openings and reduce/close positions before the profile deadline.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: this mode does not open or add to positions after {cutoff_time} ET.

rules.recovery_action: Do not open new risk; cancel openings and reduce/close positions before the profile deadline.
rules.user_message: New trades are blocked: the account is in end-of-day flattening and may only close positions.

rules.recovery_action: Wait until the configured post-earnings window ends and all market-data, news, halt, LULD, and volatility checks pass.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: {symbol} is inside its earnings-risk window from {start_time} to {end_time} ET.

rules.recovery_action: Complete the applicable quiet period and normalized-trading test after the latest related update.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: high-impact or unclassified breaking news affects {scope}. Recheck after {eligible_time} ET.

rules.recovery_action: Restore a healthy news feed with age at or below 60 seconds and re-evaluate all active news windows.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: required breaking-news data is unavailable or stale.

rules.recovery_action: Wait until the complete event window ends and satisfy the specified post-event volatility condition.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: {event_name} creates an event-risk window from {start_time} to {end_time} ET.

rules.recovery_action: Wait until the complete event window ends and satisfy the specified post-event volatility condition.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: a Federal Reserve event creates a risk window from {start_time} to {end_time} ET.

rules.recovery_action: Restore authoritative, non-conflicting calendar state and rebuild the event decision.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: required event-calendar data is missing, stale, or conflicting.

rules.recovery_action: Submit a new intent using an allowed day limit entry or approved risk-reducing exit type.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: {order_type} is not an allowed entry order type.

rules.recovery_action: Tighten the limit or reduce/cancel the intent so permitted entry slippage is within the profile maximum.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: permitted entry slippage is {projected_bps} bps; this mode allows at most {limit_bps} bps.

rules.recovery_action: Restore latency within the profile maximum, refresh all inputs, and make a new decision.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: decision-to-broker latency is {latency_ms} ms; this mode requires {limit_ms} ms or less.

rules.recovery_action: Resynchronize clocks within both tolerances and pass the read-only system health check.
rules.user_message: Trading paused: system clocks are not synchronized within the required tolerance.

rules.recovery_action: Reconcile the original intent; cancel or wait for its terminal state. A legitimate new signal must have a new signal ID and pass the debounce.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: an equivalent order is already pending or was just submitted.

rules.recovery_action: Discard the decision and perform the complete pre-trade evaluation against the newest atomic state version.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: account, broker, policy, market, or event state changed after the risk decision. The order must be re-evaluated.

rules.recovery_action: Restore single-writer ownership with a valid fencing token and serializable ledger access, then reconcile and retry as a new decision.
rules.user_message: Trading paused: exclusive account risk ownership or atomic state consistency could not be confirmed.

rules.recovery_action: Query the broker and reconcile every related order, fill, position, and reservation to a terminal known state.
rules.user_message: Trading paused: the broker outcome of a prior order is unknown and must be reconciled.

rules.recovery_action: Cancel the remainder, confirm protection or flatten filled quantity, and reconcile before any new risk.
rules.user_message: Order remainder canceled: the partial fill reached a risk limit or lacks confirmed protection.

rules.recovery_action: Record the safe rejection, refresh broker restrictions and account state, correct the stated cause, and submit a new intent; risk/unknown rejection also requires kill-switch recovery.
rules.user_message: Order rejected by the broker: {safe_broker_reason}. Trading may remain paused while account state is checked.

rules.recovery_action: Complete the heartbeat, full-reconciliation, and no-unknown-state recovery in section 9.5.
rules.user_message: Trading paused: the broker connection or authoritative account state is unavailable.

rules.recovery_action: Provide a supported server-held protective stop on the loss side and rerun the complete risk calculation.
rules.user_message: Order blocked: a valid protective stop is required and must be on the loss side of the entry.

rules.recovery_action: Restore every authoritative state source, complete startup-style reconciliation, and enter `READY` with no discrepancy.
rules.user_message: Trading paused: account risk, position, cash, or order state is unavailable or inconsistent.

rules.recovery_action: Restore durable append-only audit storage, prove the failed event is recorded or account for its gap, reconcile, and complete operator review.
rules.user_message: Trading paused: the required risk decision record could not be stored.

rules.recovery_action: Resolve the cause, reconcile, document root cause, pass health checks, then obtain the section 9.5 clearing approvals.
rules.user_message: Trading is paused by the emergency safety control. You may only cancel or reduce positions while the account is reconciled.

rules.recovery_action: Complete the recovery tied to the lock reason and the section 10 operator review/approval requirements.
rules.user_message: Trading is locked: {safe_lock_reason}. New positions remain disabled until {unlock_condition}.

rules.recovery_action: Keep the order in paper, or complete every criterion in section 13 and a separately recorded live go/no-go; the blocked order is never replayed live.
rules.user_message: Live-money execution is not enabled for this account. This order was not sent to a broker.
